_description: Canonical conformance vectors for the attestation responsible-set selection rule (_computeResponsibleSet). This rule is implemented independently in xchain-hub (AttestationRound._computeResponsibleSet) and xchain-indexer (actions/attest._computeResponsibleSet); the two MUST produce identical ordered output for the same inputs or attestation quorum evaluation forks (the hub signs with set S_hub, the indexer filters verified signatures against S_idx, and any divergence silently expires every affected request). Unlike the stake_weighted_quorum primitive this rule is not a single vendored file, so there is no byte-identity guard; each repo's conformance test instead runs these behaviour vectors against its own copy. Rule: for each validator compute SHA256(request_id || lowercased-pubkey), sort ascending by the hex hash string; when weighted, dedupe by staking source keeping the lowest-hash key per source and always keeping null-source keys; then take the first max(1, redundancy) pubkeys. This file is the single source of truth; do not fork it. Any change to either implementation must update these vectors and stay green in both repos.

computeResponsibleSet.name: weighted source dedupe drops duplicate source
redundancy larger than set returns all
weighted with redundancy 1 selects lowest-hash leader after dedupe
